Marisol: Quick sync — SiteGuard customer turnup tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need final owners for three last-mile items: egress fallback, air-gap image sync, and cert rotation. Who can own egress fallback? @Ajay @Lina

Ajay: I got egress fallback. I'll validate NAT routes + proxy-egress path. Plan: primary NAT44 -> fallback via proxy-egress in another AZ. Will drop a short playbook here (expected by 18:00 PT). :thumbsup:

Lina: I'll take air-gap image sync and registry rotation. Current plan is rsync over the sealed USB transfer path and `skopeo` for verification. Need final checksum procedure from infra.

Jeremy: I can own cert rotation and Vault access for the customer. Two asks: (1) confirm CSR flow for issuer-v2, (2) who will run the smoke cert renewal during the window? @Harper?

Harper: can run the smoke renewal during the window. Also will validate that HSM keys are present in staging. If any missing keys, call infra-oncall immediately.

Marisol: Awesome — owners noted: egress=Ajay, image-sync=Lina, certs=Jeremy+Harper. Next: dependencies. Ajay, do you need any firewall rules or peer approvals to commit fallback?

Ajay: Yes — need firewall egress rules for 10.24.0.0/16 -> proxy-egress (port 443). I opened a PR in infra-fw with diff and target change window. Link: https://git.internal/infra-fw/pull/418. Please review ASAP.

Lina: For image sync, I'll need the signed manifest access token from ops. @infra-oncall can you grant temporary read-only token to `siteguard-sync` in the next 4 hours?

infra-oncall: Acknowledged. I'll create the token and post it to the secure vault path `secret/siteguard/sync-token` with a 12h TTL. Will ping here when done.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment scheduled for 09:15 PT. If any healthchecks fail, auto-rollback after 5m. Logs will stream to #eng-runtime/canaries.

Marisol: Rollout milestones recap: 08:30 final smoke, 09:00 cutover, 09:15 canary, 09:30 full traffic. Owners: smoke=Harper, cutover=Marisol, canary=deploy-bot, rollback=Ajay. If blockers pop, escalate to infra-oncall and I'll coordinate with customer PM.

Jeremy: Quick question — do we have a manual abort procedure documented if cert renewal flaps?

Harper: Yes — `siteguard/ops/runbooks/cert-renewal.md` has abort steps and how to revert to previous cert bundle. I'll paste the important steps into this thread once I confirm path access.

Marisol: Thanks team. Action items: Ajay (fw PR + playbook), Lina (manifest token + rsync checklist), Jeremy/Harper (cert smoke + runbook snippet), infra-oncall (token + verify HSM). Report back here once done so I can confirm go/no-go by 07:30 PT. :white_check_mark:
